meta.title: How the tools connect
meta.subtitle: What moves, and who runs it
meta.description: Geometry, quantities and cost move between the tools automatically; only the authoring ends stay in your team's hands.
meta.alt: Animated diagram on a white background. Six tools sit on a ring in the order work travels through them: Rhino, Grasshopper, Revit, Excel, Power BI and the client's own cost system. Each line is labelled with what passes along it, and a dot animates from one tool to the next to show the direction.
meta.caption: Dashed boxes are yours to run. Solid lines run without anyone opening a file.
